sources: WebSearch ~50 queries (ID + EN, all 4 categories, Bandung/Jabodetabek/Jabar/online) · ~22 pages read (official expo sites, organizer news, ukmindonesia.id, rumah123.com, venue listings)
note: Thin month for Bandung Raya: no business-owner event confirmed in Bandung for 14 Nov–14 Dec 2026. Hari Ritel Nasional, Roeang Kita, BLOOM Hijabfest and IFBC already happened earlier in November. The strongest options are Jakarta trade expos (plastics, textiles, manufacturing, building materials). Organizers' Instagram accounts were not checked in this run, and many Bandung UMKM events are announced only there.

events.name: Plastics & Rubber Indonesia 2026 (37th International Plastics & Rubber Machinery, Processing & Materials Exhibition)
events.description: Annual B2B exhibition covering the plastics and rubber supply chain: machinery, processing, raw materials, moulds and recycling. Co-located with Plastic Material & Chemical and Plastic Recycling Indonesia, plus PlasPak and Mould & Die.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.organizer: PT Pamerindo Indonesia (Informa Markets), with Messe Düsseldorf Asia
events.audience: Trade visitors from the plastics and rubber industry
events.crowd: Plastic product manufacturers, packaging makers, distributors and plastics traders. Some aggregators claim 650+ exhibitors and ~20,000 visitors (unconfirmed).
events.speakers: Exhibitor count not published on the official site (counter shows a placeholder)
events.price: Not stated (online visitor pre-registration on the official site)
events.contact: Farah Alkatiri (Pamerindo) +62 21 2525 320; WhatsApp hotline on the official site
events.why: Best fit with your proof points: Nota Toko was built for a plastics and baking-supplies shop, so you can talk to plastics distributors and traders about invoicing, stock and nota from real experience. The halls are full of owners and sales directors, and almost nobody there builds software for them.
events.verified_note: Dates, venue, hours and organizer confirmed on plasticsandrubberindonesia.com (official: 17–20 Nov; several aggregators wrongly list 18–21 Nov). Visitor price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: Owners and managers of plastics converters, packaging makers and plastics distributors/traders, plus machinery and resin suppliers. Their daily pain points are stock of many SKUs (sizes and thicknesses), price lists that change with resin prices, handwritten nota and invoices, chasing receivables from resellers, and WhatsApp orders that get lost.
icebreakers: Bapak/Ibu di sini lebih banyak cari mesin baru atau cari supplier bahan baku?
Saya pernah bantu toko plastik dan bahan kue di Bandung bikin aplikasi kasir dan nota. Ternyata ribet juga ya ukuran dan jenis plastiknya banyak sekali. Di tempat Bapak/Ibu gimana?
Harga biji plastik lagi naik-turun begini, biasanya update daftar harga ke reseller gimana, Pak/Bu?

cost: Sekarang stok dan nota masih dicatat manual, pakai Excel, atau sudah pakai sistem?
Berapa sering ada selisih stok atau salah hitung harga waktu tutup buku?
Admin di kantor habis waktu paling banyak untuk apa: rekap order WA, bikin invoice, atau nagih piutang?
revenue: Pelanggan baru biasanya datang dari mana: reseller, marketplace, atau dari mulut ke mulut?
Reseller atau toko langganan bisa lihat katalog dan harga terbaru sendiri, atau harus tanya dulu lewat WA?
Ada rencana jual ke pabrik atau buyer luar kota yang lebih besar? Biasanya mereka minta apa dulu?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer yang bikin aplikasi kasir, nota, dan stok untuk usaha. Salah satunya Nota Toko, yang dipakai toko plastik dan bahan kue di Bandung. Saya juga bikin otomatisasi WhatsApp supaya order dan tagihan tidak tercecer.
prep.solution: Aplikasi stok, nota, dan invoice yang disesuaikan dengan SKU plastik Bapak/Ibu, plus katalog harga online dan pengingat tagihan otomatis lewat WhatsApp untuk reseller.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang menyebut masalah spesifik mereka (misalnya selisih stok atau update harga ke reseller), lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.name: Manufacturing Indonesia 2026
events.description: Indonesia's largest annual manufacturing exhibition, co-located with Machine Tool, Tools & Hardware, Industrial Automation, Production Logistics, and new for 2026, Fastener and Industrial Paint & Coatings Indonesia. The 2025 edition had 1,300+ exhibitors from 29 countries and 41,000+ trade attendees.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.crowd: Factory owners, plant and production managers, procurement staff, machinery and tool distributors. Large, multi-hall show.
events.speakers: 2025: 1,300+ exhibitors from 29 countries; 2026 count not yet published
events.contact: Farah Alkatiri (Pamerindo) +62 813 1191 6373; contact form on official site
events.why: A huge pool of manufacturing decision-makers in one place. The best targets are local tools, hardware and fastener distributors and small and mid-size workshops that still run stock, quotations and invoicing by hand. Many automation exhibitors sell tech themselves, so walk past them.
events.verified_note: Dates, venue, organizer and registration link confirmed on manufacturingindonesia.com. Daily hours and visitor price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: SME factory owners, workshop owners, production and procurement managers, and local distributors of tools, hardware and fasteners. Their daily pain points are quotations and price lists done in Excel, tracking orders and delivery, stock of thousands of small SKUs, and slow invoicing and collections.
icebreakers: Bapak/Ibu datang untuk cari mesin baru, atau lagi cari supplier?
Dari tadi saya lihat banyak mesin canggih, tapi penasaran juga: urusan administrasi seperti penawaran harga dan invoice di pabrik Bapak/Ibu sudah serapi mesinnya belum?
Bapak/Ibu dari daerah mana? Saya dari Bandung, banyak juga workshop dan konveksi di sana.

cost: Bikin penawaran harga atau quotation ke klien biasanya butuh berapa lama?
Stok sparepart dan bahan baku dicatat di mana, dan seberapa sering datanya tidak cocok dengan barang di gudang?
Berapa orang admin yang mengurus PO, surat jalan, dan invoice?
revenue: Pelanggan baru biasanya menemukan usaha Bapak/Ibu dari mana: website, katalog, atau sales?
Kalau ada buyer menanyakan spesifikasi produk, jawabnya cepat atau harus cari-cari file dulu?
Ada target masuk ke buyer yang lebih besar atau ekspor? Biasanya mereka minta dokumen atau katalog seperti apa?

prep.one_liner: Saya bikin aplikasi bisnis khusus untuk usaha: stok, penawaran harga, nota dan invoice, juga website katalog produk yang cepat dibuka. Di portal properti tempat saya kerja, saya memangkas ukuran halaman dari 2MB jadi 200–400KB.
prep.solution: Sistem sederhana untuk quotation, stok, dan invoice yang terhubung ke WhatsApp, ditambah katalog produk online lengkap dengan spesifikasi supaya buyer bisa cek sendiri.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan yang mengingatkan obrolan soal masalah mereka (misalnya quotation yang lama atau stok yang tidak cocok), lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.name: IndoBuildTech Expo 2026 (Part 2)
events.worth_reason: Strong exhibitor crowd, but NICE PIK 2 is the farthest venue from Bandung (~3.5–4h each way) and the show is crowded with marketing staff, so it scores just under 70. Worth it if you are already in Jakarta for INTEX (same week).
events.description: Building materials, architecture and interior exhibition (finishing, furniture, lighting, smart home) by Debindo. This is the second 2026 Jabodetabek edition; earlier 2026 editions were Bandung (May) and ICE BSD (July).
events.organizer: PT Debindo International Trade and Exhibitions
events.audience: Buyers, manufacturers, architects, contractors and the public (per organizer: 'key buyers, manufacturers, and visitors')
events.crowd: Building-material and interior brands, furniture manufacturers, distributors, contractors, developers and architects
events.speakers: Exhibitor count for this edition not stated
events.why: It sits where your property-domain knowledge meets manufacturing: furniture and interior makers, material distributors and contractors who need product catalogs, quotation tools and lead follow-up on WhatsApp. Your Rumah123 background gives you credibility with developers and contractors.
events.verified_note: Dates (25–29 Nov 2026), venue NICE PIK 2, organizer and registration link confirmed on indobuildtech.com. Hours and price not stated. Instagram not checked.

prep.who: Owners of furniture and interior workshops, building-material distributors, contractors and small developers. Their daily pain points are many enquiries on WhatsApp that never turn into orders, slow manual quotations or RAB, catalogs kept as heavy PDFs, and project and payment tracking.
icebreakers: Booth-nya ramai sekali. Biasanya dari pameran begini, berapa banyak yang benar-benar jadi order?
Saya kerja di portal properti, jadi sering lihat developer kesulitan follow-up leads. Di bisnis interior atau material, masalahnya mirip tidak, Pak/Bu?
Produk ini biasanya lebih banyak dibeli kontraktor atau langsung pemilik rumah?

cost: Bikin penawaran atau RAB untuk satu proyek biasanya butuh berapa lama?
Leads dari pameran dan WhatsApp dicatat di mana? Pernah ada yang lupa di-follow-up?
Progres proyek dan termin pembayaran sekarang dipantau pakai apa?
revenue: Katalog produk dikirim ke calon pembeli dalam bentuk apa: PDF, Instagram, atau website?
Dari semua yang menanyakan harga, kira-kira berapa persen yang akhirnya beli?
Ada rencana menyasar developer perumahan atau proyek yang lebih besar?

prep.one_liner: Saya engineer di portal properti dan biasa membuat website katalog yang cepat dibuka serta aplikasi penawaran harga dan follow-up lewat WhatsApp untuk usaha. Tujuannya supaya leads dari pameran tidak hilang begitu saja.
prep.solution: Katalog produk online yang ringan, ditambah alat penawaran harga sederhana dan pengingat follow-up otomatis di WhatsApp untuk setiap lead.
prep.follow_up: Minta nomor WhatsApp. Dalam 24 jam kirim pesan soal masalah leads atau penawaran yang mereka ceritakan, lalu tawarkan ngobrol gratis 15 menit untuk melihat alur kerja mereka sekarang.

events.name: INTEX 2026 – Indonesia International Textile Expo
events.worth_reason: After the Jakarta travel deduction it lands just under 70. Exhibitor origins are not published, and if most booths are overseas suppliers, your prospects (Bandung garment and konveksi owners) are fellow visitors, who are harder to approach than exhibitors. Combine with IndoBuildTech the same week if you go.
events.description: Textile and apparel sourcing show covering fabrics, garments, home textiles, bags and footwear, accessories and trims, and raw materials.
events.distance: ~3h each way from Bandung (Whoosh/train or car)
events.crowd: Garment makers, konveksi owners, fashion brands and fabric traders. Exhibitor numbers not published (aggregator claims of 10,000+ exhibitors look unreliable).
events.why: Bandung is a garment and konveksi hub, and many of the visitors will be owners from there. Their pain points (order tracking, production status, invoicing resellers) match the apps you build.
events.verified_note: Dates 25–28 Nov 2026, JIExpo Kemayoran and organizer confirmed on intexexpo.com. Hall (C3 per one aggregator), hours, price and exhibitor count not confirmed. Instagram not checked.

events.name: Pertamina SMEXPO 2026 (national exhibition)
events.worth_reason: Only 14–15 Nov are left (today and tomorrow), so it means a last-minute ~3h trip each way. Small show (40 booths) in a mall atrium with mostly public shoppers. Note the program for next year instead.
events.format: Expo / bazaar with B2B business matching
events.description: Pertamina's national showcase for its fostered UMKM, themed 'Lokal Jadi Vokal'. 52 UMKM were selected from ~600 applicants: 40 with booths, the rest on consignment. The target is Rp34 billion in B2B transactions with corporate buyers.
events.crowd: 40 UMKM booths (food, fashion, craft) with owners on site, plus mall visitors
events.speakers: Temmy Satya Permana (Kementerian UMKM), Tony Andrianto (Danantara) at opening
events.why: The booths are staffed by owners of curated, growth-stage UMKM who are already selling B2B, a good audience for order, stock and catalog tools. The time left is the problem.
events.verified_note: Dates and venue confirmed by 11 Nov 2026 news reports (RMOL, journalarta). No official Pertamina event page found. Hours, entry price and contact not confirmed. Instagram not checked.

events.name: Open Call Desa Bisa Ekspor 2026 – Sektor Pertanian (Lembang edition)
events.description: Kemendag and Local Champion Indonesia export training for vegetable farmers and agri-businesses in Lembang and nearby areas, focused on the Taiwan and Singapore markets.
events.organizer: Kementerian Perdagangan (Kemendag) with Local Champion Indonesia
events.crowd: Small farm owners and agri-SME operators
events.why: These are export-minded agri owners close to home, who may need a product catalog for export buyers. But it is a closed cohort for farmers. You would need to ask the organizer whether a facilitator or mentor slot is possible.
events.verified_note: Program dates, venue and deadline are not published (the article says to ask the contact person). It may fall outside the window or already be full. Participant-only, so outsider access is unconfirmed.

events.name: PropVaganza 2026 by Rumah123 – Central Park
events.worth_reason: Consumer property fair in a mall atrium. Exhibitors are mostly developers' marketing staff, not owners, and the 2026 dates are unconfirmed. It is also your employer's own event, so it is not a neutral place to pitch side work.
events.description: Rumah123's annual series of property fairs in malls, with developer promos, KPR consultations and talkshows. A May 2026 report lists a December stop at Central Park.
events.crowd: Public home seekers and developer sales teams
events.why: Low client potential. Listed only for completeness in the property category.
events.verified_note: Only the month (December 2026) comes from a May 2026 news article. rumah123.com/events shows only the 2025 Central Park edition (2–7 Dec 2025) and '2027 coming soon'. 2026 dates are unconfirmed and may fall outside the window.
